reviewer: Claude (strict art QC, bodies and heads group)
cross_cell_inconsistencies: Trousers: front/left/right are brown-grey, lighter, scuffed fabric; back and three_quarter are near-black charcoal.
Boots: front/left/right are brown-grey scuffed leather lace-ups; back and three_quarter are plain black boots.
Sweater: front/left/right have a flat stand collar and no ribbed cuffs; back and three_quarter have visible ribbed cuffs and a different knit (three_quarter has a crew neck with a collar on top).
Braids: short (end at chest) in front, long (to mid-back) in back view; side views show only one thin braid with dark clips at the collar.
Moustache/chin: body_front has a clean chin; all head cells have a soul patch plus stubble; three_quarter body has a short thick moustache and heavy stubble (different man-ish).

Heads: head_front has loose wavy hair and no visible braids; head_profile has a scalp plait instead of hanging braids; head_back has braids hanging; head_top has costume (crimson collar) that must not be in a head cell.
Body left and right are not A-pose: arms hang forward near the thighs, legs wide.
